category_title: Students who display hostility toward diversity-related course content
minimal_context: The student is attending a class session where a presentation on Planned Parenthood and abortion is being shown.
dialogue:
TUTOR: For today's class session, we will be viewing a presentation on Planned Parenthood and abortion.

STUDENT: Why are we watching this? This content completely challenges my core values and beliefs.

TUTOR: Please just watch the presentation for now.

STUDENT: (Proclaiming in a public bullying display) I’m not going to listen to some bullshit liberal attitude about Planned Parenthood and abortion.

TUTOR: Please sit down and let the presentation continue.

STUDENT: No! You are just a supporter of murderers!

options.A: Ensure a feeling of safety, a sense that the student is accepted, and encourage mutual support.
options.B: Make additions to the course syllabus to proactively deal with potential triggers during class sessions.
options.C: Maintain a high ratio of praise statements to error correction statements (e.g., 3:1 to 10:1).
options.D: Provide support in small groups (comprising three to five students) or individually outside the class session.
